name: The Aether
description: The Aether is a dimension of floating islands above a sea of clouds.

pages.title: The Aether
pages.text: **The Aether** is a dimension of floating islands above a sea of clouds. It has its own mobs, materials and three dungeons.

To get there, build a frame of **Glowstone** and place water in it. The portal swirls blue.\
\
The mod can also give new players a portal frame item, set by [#](7A3C9A)[config](entry://glossary/config)[#]().

pages.title: Aether Portal Frame
pages.text: Glowstone frame plus water makes the portal.

pages.title: Holystone
pages.text: The Aether's main stone. Dungeons use Carved, Angelic and Hellfire stone and need Bronze, Silver and Gold keys.

pages.title: Zanite Gemstone
pages.text: The Aether's tool and armor gem. Gravitite and Valkyrie gear come later.

pages.title: Ambrosium Shard
pages.text: Lights Aether furnaces and heals. Golden Amber comes from golden oak trees.

The Aether's dungeons hold keys and a boss each: Bronze, Silver and Gold, ending in the Slider, Valkyrie Queen and Sun Spirit.\
\
Parachute items make falling off the islands survivable.

pages.title: Cold Parachute
pages.text: A parachute for falling off the islands. A [Golden Parachute](item://aether:golden_parachute) is the sturdier version.

Gear from the Aether stacks with other mods. The [Invisibility Cloak](item://aether:invisibility_cloak) toggles with **=** by default here.\
\
Bosses are in [#](2E5AAC)[Bosses](entry://exploration/bosses)[#](); travel is in [#](2E5AAC)[Dimensions](entry://exploration/dimensions)[#]().
